descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S11 Never left waiting with nothing: both models fail, a working state shows at once and the failure arrives within the budget

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • T3 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s (TFA-94422 AC 7; UAT 3.5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack with Haiku and Mistral both failing as temporary errors; one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident

When Type the dictation, tap Generate Note & Finish, snapshot at once, then again when the screen settles

Then Right after the tap the button shows it is generating (never idle with no feedback); within ~30 s of the tap the explicit failure shows, the dictation is still in the box and Generate Note & Finish is offered again; Post-Round has no blank note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): cp1 mustContain 'generating'. cp2 / cp3 mustContain the typed dictation, 'Generate Note & Finish' and 'couldn’t be generated' (any explicit message, as both main copies say), plus 'Note not generated' as a known gap (Q3: reported as Fail (known), not as a silent pass), and mustNotContain 'AI-Generated Note'. Backend: no note stored and the chart not finished. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S11

Never left waiting with nothing: both models fail, a working state shows at once and the failure arrives within the budget

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane probes: status blocked in probes/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: partly): Scripted probe both contexts: the client's ai/notes:generateNote answer is failed at the Convex socket after 20 s (both models failing incl. retries); snapshot right after the tap (generating), then after settle: dictation kept, Generate offered again, explicit failure, no AI note, nothing stored, status not finished, Post-Round no blank note; tap-to-message ms recorded. [Review 2026-10-14] Adds the known-gap soft failure for 'Note not generated' (Q3, Fail (known)). Still gated by QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE; question to Quinn whether S11 (no model call) may run without it. — What the physician sees and what is stored are judged; the server retry/fallback budget is not exercised (fault env var refused on the shared backend).

Detail:

Built (generateNote answer failed at the client socket after 20 s; checks: 'generating' at once, explicit failure, dictation kept, nothing stored, status not finished, no blank Post-Round note). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13; dev only). The spec is built and skips itself; run it with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1 once Quinn OKs local Generate. It makes no model call (the action never reaches the server). Review 2026-10-14: the spec now also soft-fails, annotated knownGap, when 'Note not generated' is missing after the failure (oracle: Fail (known) for Q3, not a silent pass). Question for Quinn: S11 makes no model call (the generateNote answer is failed at the client socket), so may it run without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE?

Evidence: 0 attached; 1 not attached:

  • web/qa-agent-tests/probes/oat03-generate-faults.spec.ts — outside the local run folder, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack with both models failing on every attempt (a server seam, fault-ai; a fallback of 'none' needs aiProvider:_set, which is forbidden on every target).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
